from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,json,os,statistics,hashlib
work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=work.parent
os.environ['PC_WORK']=str(work/'measure')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pc',root/'experiments/perf-gc-dict-20260925/scripts/pc.py')
pc=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(pc)
pc.LOX_BENCH=root.parent/'d9-stage3b/.tmp-cow/pc/lox/bench';pc.LOX_PORT=work/'port'
ids=['method_call','closures','binary_trees','fib','trees']
programs=[next(p for p in pc.programs() if p['id']=='lox/vm/'+name) for name in ids]
results={'cpu':11,'builds':json.loads((work/'hoist-builds.json').read_text()),'samples':{}}
for p in programs:
 runs={side:pc.run_spec(p,work/f'lox-{side}-llvm',side) for side in ['hoist-before','hoist']}
 row={'checks':{side:pc.check(p,run) for side,run in runs.items()},'counts':{side:[] for side in runs},'size':p['size']}
 assert all(c['ok'] for c in row['checks'].values()),row
 for rep in range(3):
  for side in (['hoist-before','hoist'] if rep%2==0 else ['hoist','hoist-before']):
   one=pc.perf_counts(runs[side],11)
   assert one['status']==0 and 'instructions' in one,one
   row['counts'][side].append(one)
 row['medians']={side:statistics.median(c['instructions'] for c in counts) for side,counts in row['counts'].items()}
 row['ratio']=row['medians']['hoist']/row['medians']['hoist-before']
 results['samples'][p['id']]=row
 (work/'hoist-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(p['id'],row['ratio'],row['medians'],flush=True)
